title: Bind the audited authority-text diff to the landed tree

acceptance: The audit or the landing confirms that the audited authority-text diff is the diff of the tree that lands (post-landing comparison of the landed commit's authority-text diff with the audited diff, or an auditor-run freeze check against the supplied fingerprint)
